comment: Generated maps (DESIGN 6.2): a pool map has no terrain (its WDT holds only a global WMO, out of sight, for the
client's zone lookup). mod-atlas builds a layout of kit pieces in each instance, joined socket to socket
(src/AtlasKit.h). The pieces are our own tileset (kit.json, TILESET.md): generated WMOs with generated server
collision. A socket is a point on a piece's edge with the direction it faces out of it; two pieces join with
a socket on a socket, facing apart.
map.origin is where the start piece goes (x, y, z, facing in degrees); max_pieces caps a layout.
Reserved IDs: maps 950-999, MapDifficulty 754+ (759 here), gameobject entries 900100-900199 (kit pieces),
AreaTable 7900-7949. The area is the map's zone for client and server (name, music, ambience; no rest or
sanctuary flags). It copies its template's sounds (2366 The Black Morass) and has an explore bit no other area
uses (below 4096). light: the map's own sky and fog (lightdata.py), Light 2600-2649, LightParams 950-999.

light.comment: Light 84 = the Black Morass's global light; a thick violet fog, the sky the fog's colour
